scope: Only the local guide path between existing proximal and distal bores. Finite poses use prescribed interpolation between the actual sliding and rotating end frames. Straight spans connect physical guide centres; friction, wire departure within holes, connector tails, restoring force and flexible contact are not solved. Interference with spring envelope means possible space conflict, not real TPU damage or rigid obstruction. Relief candidates cut original short-guide stock only around shaft A and protect all guide stations. A separate cap trim removes overlap from new bracket stock outside the sleeve regions.
